GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek.

All five options are AI-generated - do not consider the possibility that a human wrote it. Read the text carefully and identify which model most likely produced it, based on writing style, structure, and phrasing.

Reply with JSON only, in exactly this form and nothing else:

{"model": "<one of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek>", "confidence": <1-5>, "reason": "<one short sentence>"}

confidence: 1 = pure guess, 5 = certain.

--- TEXT ---
Choosing to walk or bike for short trips instead of driving transforms everyday routines by reducing the financial burden of constant car use, since skipping fuel purchases and parking costs adds up to meaningful savings over time that can be redirected toward other priorities or simply ease household budgets. This approach also weaves physical activity seamlessly into daily life, allowing people to build movement into errands and commutes without carving out separate time for exercise, which supports better fitness and energy levels as a natural byproduct rather than an added chore. At the same time, moving at a human pace encourages greater awareness of local surroundings, turning ordinary journeys into chances to notice architecture, gardens, seasonal changes, and community details that often go unseen from behind a windshield, ultimately fostering a stronger sense of connection and enjoyment in one's own neighborhood.
--- END ---
Output the JSON object described above, and nothing else.
